obligations.description: Copy /spec/support/Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean unchanged to the corresponding project module and import it. Work with Research.FloatingPoint.Model, using its u_nonneg and round_spec; introduce no extra model assumptions or custom axioms.
Define P on List ℝ and x : ℝ by structural recursion: P [] x = 0 and P (a :: tail) x = a + x * P tail x. The head is the constant coefficient, so lists are in increasing degree order.

Define Q for an arbitrary supplied Model by structural recursion: Q model [] x = 0 and Q model (a :: tail) x = model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)). Each cons step must have exactly the specified one rounded multiplication and one rounded addition.

Define E on List ℝ, x : ℝ, and u : ℝ without referring to Q, round, or rounding witnesses. Set E [] x u = 0. With v = P tail x and e = E tail x u, set E (a :: tail) x u = u * |a + x*v| + (1+u) * (u * |x*v| + (1+u) * |x| * e). Preserve this exact recurrence rather than substituting a different forward bound.

Obtain a reusable perturbation bound for arbitrary real z and t: |model.round z - t| ≤ model.u * |t| + (1 + model.u) * |z - t|. Derive it solely from round_spec, absolute-value triangle and product identities, and u_nonneg. One convenient intermediate bound is |round z - z| ≤ u * |z|, followed by |z| ≤ |t| + |z-t|. Ensure every multiplication of inequalities has a justified nonnegative factor.

In the list induction, use the induction hypothesis |Q tail x - P tail x| ≤ E tail x u and abs_mul to control |x * Q tail x - x * P tail x| by |x| * E tail x u. Apply the rounding perturbation bound with z = x * Q tail x and t = x * P tail x to obtain the inner error bound u * |x * P tail x| + (1+u) * |x| * E tail x u.

Apply the same perturbation bound to z = a + round (x * Q tail x) and t = a + x * P tail x. Cancel the common a in z-t, then insert the inner multiplication bound under the nonnegative factor 1+u. The resulting expression is exactly the required cons envelope after associativity normalization.

State and establish |Q model coefficients x - P coefficients x| ≤ E coefficients x model.u for every Model, every finite real coefficient list, and every real x. Use structural list induction; the empty case reduces to zero. Do not assume small u, positive or nonzero x, sign restrictions on coefficients, exact rounding of any special input, or exact intermediate arithmetic.

Check the completed formalization using local Lean and Mathlib. All recursive definitions and the theorem must elaborate without sorry, placeholders, or new axioms; verify that the supplied prerequisite remains unchanged and that the final theorem uses the constructed evaluators and the prescribed envelope.

strategy: Construct P, Q, and E explicitly by recursion on the coefficient list, then connect those constructions through a universally quantified forward-error theorem. Prove a generic rounding perturbation estimate once and use it twice per induction step: multiplication transfers the tail error with factor |x| and one factor 1+u; addition transfers that whole inner bound with a second factor 1+u and contributes u*|a+x*v|. This reproduces the source recurrence exactly. Use abs_mul, triangle inequalities, and nonnegative multiplication for estimates, with ring-style normalization only for algebraic identities. The exact evaluator and envelope depend only on the prescribed exact data, while Q alone depends on round. No feedback file was present at planning time. This plan specifies constructions and proof obligations, not a completed target proof.
